speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for sharing that history. To better understand the nature of your episodic cough and shortness of breath, can you describe the color of any sputum you produce and whether these symptoms are triggered by exercise or specific environments?

speaker: Patient
text: 59-year-old female. The patient reports a 1-month history of episodic cough and shortness of breath. The cough is nonproductive and worsens when climbing stairs and at night. She experienced fever, sore throat, and nasal congestion 8 weeks ago.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Asthma exacerbation or post-viral reactive airway disease. The combination of nonproductive cough, dyspnea on exertion, nocturnal symptoms, and recent upper respiratory infection history is classic for these conditions. No further tests are required at this moment; I will recommend a trial of bronchodilators and inhaled corticosteroids.
